    dy = pos.y - 10.0

    # Dot product to detect swing direction
    dot_product = dx * vel.x + dy * vel.y

    if pos.y < target_y and dot_product > 0:

            tangential_dir_y /= length

        fy = 42.0 * tangential_dir_y
        sandbox.apply_force_to_seat(fx, fy)
